posts.author: Comrade Yuskolov
posts.title: Making an RP map
posts.html:
Well, as it says in the title, I am making an RP map. But I am not making it by myself, I am making it with Shen-Chan. At the moment as I am typing, we are just starting it.
Our idea is to make seperate buildings and then put it together, we are going to make a city like in Evocity, and then branch off and make other areas. I am mainly posting this to ask Lexi if it is Ok (If I need permssion) to base everything around the jobs in AppleJack(Well, now Moonshine).

Even though it may be a while, or I may start a new thread for it, stay tuned for pics!  [image not archived: Wink]
